name: Lyon BD Festival
blurb: Lyon's international comics festival: free author signings, exhibitions and talks each June, now in its third decade.
notes: Most recent (21st) edition ran 12-14 June 2026, marking the festival's 20th anniversary; already past as of 2026-10-05. No 22nd-edition date has been announced yet on the official site, so editions is empty. Cover uses the 2026 poster ('affiche'), illustrated by Zeina Abirached.
